notes: USMLE Content Outline 2026 supports COPD within Respiratory System content and patient-centered counseling/enabling patient behaviors within Communication and Interpersonal Skills.
AHRQ explicitly defines the 5 A's as Ask, Advise, Assess, Assist, and Arrange and defines Assess as determining willingness to make a quit attempt.
AHRQ EvidenceNOW provides a 5As implementation flowchart based on readiness to quit.
USPSTF clinician guidance lists the 5 A's as an implementation approach for tobacco-cessation care.
An earlier Q0662 teach-back draft was rejected before audit because an expanded generic gate found direct canonical overlap with Q0095 and Q0296.

official_outline_path: Respiratory System — obstructive airway disease: COPD
Social Sciences — Communication and interpersonal skills
Patient-centered communication skills — enabling patient behaviors through education and counseling

teachback_rejected_overlap: Q0296 includes plain language plus teach-back as the uniquely best communication strategy.
duplicate_gate.motivational_interviewing_rejected_overl: Canonical Q0200 directly tests motivational interviewing for smoking-related behavior change.
duplicate_gate.selected_construct: 5 A's tobacco-cessation counseling — Assess willingness to quit

claim_audit.five_As_sequence: PASS — Ask, Advise, Assess, Assist, Arrange.
claim_audit.assess_definition: PASS — determine willingness to make a quit attempt at this time.
claim_audit.assist_after_assess: PASS — quit-plan/pharmacotherapy assistance follows willingness assessment for a patient ready to quit.
claim_audit.arrange_after_assistance: PASS — follow-up is arranged after prior steps.
claim_audit.motivational_intervention_not_target: PASS — motivational intervention applies when a patient is not willing; readiness has not yet been assessed in the vignette.

option_audit.assess_willingness: Uniquely follows completed Ask and Advise steps.
option_audit.immediate_medication: Prematurely jumps to Assist before assessing willingness.
option_audit.repeat_tobacco_question: Repeats the already completed Ask step.
option_audit.barrier_discussion: May be useful after identifying unwillingness, but the patient has not yet been assessed for willingness.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: The physician has already identified tobacco use and explicitly advised cessation. In the 5 A's model the next step is Assess willingness to make a quit attempt.
adversarial_second_pass.assist_attack: Assistance is appropriate only after the clinician knows whether the patient is ready to try quitting now.
adversarial_second_pass.arrange_attack: Follow-up is downstream from assessment and assistance.
adversarial_second_pass.motivational_interviewing_attack: The item does not test generic motivational interviewing; direct MI constructs were rejected because Q0200 already covers them.
adversarial_second_pass.teachback_attack: The rejected teach-back version is not the final construct and has no audit/DB write.
adversarial_second_pass.unsupported_precision_check: No quit-date interval, medication dose, abstinence percentage, pack-year threshold, or follow-up timing is required for the correct answer.
